Market notes, October 2026: Vaughan, Richmond Hill and Markham

Three York Region cities side by side, with what the numbers mean if you're buying or selling north of Steeles.

Ali Bayat
Figures checked against the sources below on November 21, 2026
Published November 21, 2026

Source: TRREB Market Watch, October 2026. All home types. Thornhill is split between Vaughan and Markham.

03What stands out

Markham

Tightest of the three

Lowest inventory (4.1 months) and fastest sales.

Richmond Hill

Most choice

5.5 months of inventory: buyers can take their time and negotiate.

Vaughan

Highest average price

But homes took a bit longer to sell, 33 days on average.

Ali's take

If you're comparing a home in Vaughan with one in North York, remember York Region has no municipal land transfer tax. That can be worth $16,000 or more at closing.
